summary: Sungdoo Ahn is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar. He earned his PhD at the University of Hamburg under Lambert Schmithausen, served as Director at Geumgang University, and held a professorship at Seoul National University (attested 2013).

Sungtaek Cho is a Buddhist studies and philosophy scholar who studied at Konkuk University and Korea University. He held positions at Stony Brook University, Gyeonggi Research Institute, and Korea University, where he was Director (attested 2012–2017) and Research Professor (2019–2020).
Sunhee Kim completed a Doctor of Philosophy in Performance Practice at the University of Exeter under the supervision of Phillip B. Zarrilli (attested 2013).

Suniti Kumar Chatterji was an Indologist and linguist who studied at the University of Calcutta, University of London, and Sorbonne. He was Khaira Professor at the University of Calcutta (1922–1952) and Government of India National Professor in Humanities (~1965–1977).

Sunny Kumar is an Indology scholar who earned his Ph.D. at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University (2013–2015). In 2016, he served as Assistant Professor at Gorakshanath Government Sanskrit College.
Supree Kanjanapisarn is a scholar in religious studies and philosophy who earned a PhD at Assumption University under the supervision of Veerachart Nimanong (attested 2011).
Surabhi Verma specializes in Indology and philosophy. She completed her Ph.D. at Panjab University (2012–2015) and was an Assistant Professor at the National Institute of Technology Rourkela in 2015.

Surama Dasgupta was a scholar of philosophy and Indology who studied under Surendranath Dasgupta, earning degrees from the University of Calcutta and a Ph.D. from the University of Cambridge (-1948). She served as Reader at the University of Lucknow.
Suren Naicker is a scholar in linguistics, Indology, and religious studies. He earned a D Litt et Phil at the University of South Africa and held a post there.
Surendra Man Bajracharya is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed his PhD at Tribhuvan University under the supervision of Bhadra Ratna Bajracharya and co-supervisor Ranjana Bajracharya.

Surendranath Dasgupta was an Indologist and philosopher who earned Ph.Ds from Calcutta and Cambridge. He served as Principal of Sanskrit College and University (~1931–1942), Sampurnanand Sanskrit University (~1940–1942), and held the Chair of Philosophy at Calcutta (~1942–1945).
Surendranath Majumdar Sastri was an Indology and archaeology scholar who studied under traditional teacher Hara Prasad Sastri. He served as a Reader at Patna University (attested 1924).

Suresha R. is an Indology and philosophy scholar. He held a post at the University of Mysore in 2013 and served as an Assistant Professor at Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute (attested 2026).
Surya Das is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied at the University at Buffalo (~1967–1971) and trained under traditional teacher Nyoshul Khenpo Rinpoche (~1980–1999).

Surya Kanta was an Indologist and linguist who earned his D.Phil. at the University of Oxford (-1937) under Frederick William Thomas. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of the Punjab (attested 1939).

Surya Tahora works in philosophy and Indology, holding degrees from Aix-Marseille, Paris-Sud, and Arsha Vidya Gurukulam. In 2021, he served as Executive Director at S. P. Jain Institute of Management and Research.

Suryakumar Bhuyan was an Indology and history scholar who studied at Presidency University, Calcutta, and SOAS. He was Principal at Cotton University (1918) and Vice Chancellor at Gauhati University (~1957–1960).

Suryanarayana Shukla was a scholar of Indology, linguistics, and philosophy. He studied at Rajgopal Sanskrit Mahavidyalaya under Nandakishore Pandey, Ramanujacharya, and Shridatta Pandey, and later served as a professor at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.
Susan Andrews is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned her PhD at Columbia University (attested 2013) under doctoral supervisor Chün-fang Yü.

Susan Hawthorne is an Indology and philosophy scholar educated at Melbourne Teachers' College, La Trobe University, Australian National University, and the University of Melbourne (PhD 1999–2002). She was an Adjunct Professor at James Cook University in 2018.
